premises: High-strain-rate deformation can induce dynamic nanoclustering of principal elements at grain boundaries in a single-phase HEA.
This dynamic nanoclustering reduces grain boundary cohesion and promotes cavitation.
The proposed mechanism is distinct from equilibrium segregation or intermetallic precipitation.
The mechanism leads to brittle intergranular fracture and reduced toughness.
